question:
Select the most appropriate homonym.

His name has been **cleared** of all charges.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Exonerated)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cleared"** in this context means to free someone from blame or charges, indicating they are no longer guilty of wrongdoing. (दोषमुक्त करना)
 
 
• **Example:** After thorough investigation, the suspect was cleared of all allegations.
 
 
• **"Exonerated"** means to officially declare someone free from blame, guilt, or responsibility, usually after being accused of wrongdoing. (निर्दोष साबित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The court exonerated him after new evidence proved his innocence.
 
 
• Hence, the word "Exonerated" aligns perfectly with the meaning of "Cleared" in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Exonerated)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shifted** (स्थानांतरित): Moved from one place to another or changed position.
 
 
• **Example:** The books were shifted to another shelf for better organization.
 
 
 
• **Removed** (हटाना): Taken away or eliminated from a particular place or context.
 
 
• **Example:** The manager removed the outdated files from the database.
 
 
 
• **Made Clean** (साफ करना): To physically clean or make something free of dirt.
 
 
• **Example:** She made the living room clean before the guests arrived.
 
 

Question: His name has been cleared of all charges. Select the most appropriate homonym.

The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Exonerated)**.
